subject: Finite-field discriminant when the characteristic lowers the derivative degree
mathematical_definition: Universal coefficient discriminant, equivalently signed Sylvester determinant with derivative padded to formal degree n-1 divided by the leading coefficient
finding: The pinned oracle uses the actual derivative degree in the resultant without correcting the leading-coefficient power. For these nonmonic polynomials, its GF(p) discriminant disagrees with both integer discriminant specialization and an independently assembled formal Sylvester determinant.
policy: The checked native and public finite-field operation computes the mathematical discriminant. These known mismatches are recorded explicitly and excluded from parity claims, not hidden by changing a comparator or expected oracle result. No frozen profile or gate is promoted.
evidence: Both integer discriminants, actual-degree GF outputs and independent formal Sylvester determinants were executed against the pin; native candidate execution is recorded separately in the feature audit.
